plot: On a sunny garden morning Dog suddenly walks, talks and plays backwards; Max checks if Dog is sick, then thinks Dog is upset with him, then tries copying the game and lands in the flowers, while the backwards habit spreads to Bird and Mouse; just before Dog backs into Grandma's tray Max learns the news came from fast-talking Bird and, putting it together with the sweet smell, works out himself that Grandma had said upside-down CAKE day, not upside-down day.

script.title: Why Is Dog Doing Everything Backwards?

beats.say: Bye, Max! Bye-bye! Good night!
Good night? It's morning! Why is Dog doing everything backwards?
It is a sunny morning in Grandma's garden. And Dog walks backwards.
Morning good, Max! Day lovely a it's!
Morning good? Day lovely? Dog, your words are all mixed up!
Big news! Grandma says today is upside-down! Pass it on!
And Bird zooms away before Max can ask her one thing.
From Grandma's open window comes a sweet smell, and a happy hum.
Bird always talks too fast. Never mind. Dog, are you okay?
Okay I am! Fine very! Yesterday you see!
Dog throws his red ball. Then Dog runs the other way!
A dog who runs away from his ball? Something is very wrong.
What's wrong, Max? Your tail is all puffy and big.
Dog is doing everything backwards! I think Dog is sick.
Sick? Then let's check! Is his nose cold and wet?
Max tiptoes up. Dog gives him a big lick, on the tail.
Cold nose. Waggy tail. Big lick. Dog is not sick at all!
Then why is he doing everything backwards? Think, Max, think!
Guess two. Maybe Dog is upset with me. Maybe it's my fault.
Yesterday Max took the best sunny spot. Dog got none.
Dog, I'm sorry about the sun spot! Please walk the right way!
Sorry? For what? Fun much so is this!
Dog walks backwards in a big, happy circle. Round and round.
He's not upset. He's having the best day ever!
Not sick. Not upset. Then what is it? I have to know!
Then it happens again. Bird flies past, tail first. Backwards!
Bye, Max! I just came to say hello!
Oh no! Now Bird is backwards too! It's spreading!
If this keeps going, the whole garden will go backwards!
Even Grandma! She'll wear her hat on her feet!
Mouse gasps. Then her little feet take one step... backwards.
Oops! My feet did it by themselves! It's so catchy!
Not you too, Mouse! Okay. Stay calm. I need a clever guess.
Guess three! It's a game! Dog is playing Copy Me Backwards!
So Max walks backwards too. Step, step, step... into the flowers. Plop!
Look! Max is a flower now! A very orange flower!
Ow. Petals in my ears. Dog, is this a game or not?
Game? No game! Special day very a it's!
A special day? What special day? Dog, please, tell me!
But Dog only wags, and walks backwards behind the bushes.
Max, look! The kitchen door is opening! Grandma's coming out!
Grandma steps out with a big tray. It's covered with a cloth.
Uh-oh. Dog walks backwards, so Dog can't see where he goes!
If Dog bumps Grandma, her tray goes SPLAT! We must stop it!
And there's Dog, backing out of the bushes, right toward Grandma.
Dog! Wait! Please stop for one second!
Stop? I can't! Today is upside-down! Bird said so!
Bird! Is that true? Did you tell Dog to walk backwards?
I told everyone! Grandma said it! I heard her from the window!
So it's not Dog at all. The backwards news came from Bird!
Bird hears things very fast. And Bird says things very fast.
Max lifts his nose. That sweet smell is coming from Grandma's tray.
Fast words, plus a sweet smell... I know! Dog, turn around!
Dog turns around, just one paw away from Grandma's tray. Phew!
My goodness! Why is everyone walking backwards today?
Because you said so! You said today is upside-down day!
Grandma, I think you said something sweeter. Upside-down cake day!
Yes, Max! I said upside-down CAKE day! Not upside-down day!
Fruit goes on the bottom, then you flip it over. Ta-da!
Oops! Cake day, not upside-down day! My ears were too fast!
So I walked backwards all morning for a cake? Worth it!
Next time you hear big news, come and ask me first.
So everyone eats upside-down cake. The right way up!
Tomorrow, let's find out why Bird sleeps standing on one foot!
